title: "King Matthias Is Dead, Justice Has Perished" - Meghalt Mátyás, oda az igazság
grammar: Proverbs & collective memorial: Meghalt Mátyás, oda az igazság

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say when and where King Matthias died and where he was buried.
I can explain the proverb 'Meghalt Mátyás, oda az igazság' and what it says about his death.
I can say what happened after 1490: a struggle for the throne and the end of the Black Army.
I can use the new vocabulary about death, mourning and memory.
